name: check_joint_path_collision
summary: Reject active-arm environment, non-adjacent self and stationary other-arm overlaps at joint-path samples.

generality.rationale: Task-independent joint-path predicate, limited to world-mounted revolute serial chains and static box obstacles.
assumptions: Public URDF collision geometry matches the profile and observed obstacles cover the relevant environment.
limitations: Conservative mesh boxes may overreject; samples can miss continuous collisions.
Directly adjacent active links are excluded; no fixed-chassis, passive/gripper or synchronized dual-arm checks.
Other arms are static measured snapshots; partial scene maps leave unseen space unknown.
tested_tasks: Synthetic rotated-box, self, stationary inter-arm and joint-path regression fixtures
Recorded turn-switch failed approach, offline public model replay; no new task success claim

level.rationale: One deterministic physical predicate using FK, mesh bounds and sampled box intersection.

provenance.failure_gap: Complete endpoint IK accepted a forearm configuration intersecting the table.
evidence: Recorded approach FK and STL vertices penetrate the offline tabletop regression box.
